decision: work in one PR against nico/f-prime-constraints-cuda-formal and go phase by phase through docs/handoff/aeneas/plan.md
why: the owner asked for one PR for the whole workstream and full autonomy while away

decision: done means: each finished phase passes its plan check locally, the aeneas CI job is green on GitHub, and every unfinished phase is named with its reason
why: a checkable end state, so the run cannot declare victory early

decision: keep this log at .audit/aeneas.tsv and commit it in the PR
why: the owner wants to review the decisions later, and docs/ is not in git

decision: moved split and variables from neo-spartan into the new crate neo-verified as the seed for the gate
why: the gate needs real translated code to check, and these two already had pilot proofs

decision: rewrote split and variables with checked_sub, leading_zeros and wrapping_shl, no next_power_of_two or trailing_zeros
why: Aeneas has no model for those two, and plain arithmetic is banned by the code rules
result: proof bytes unchanged (pin passes on old and new code)

decision: put the translation in formal/compression-lean/NeoVerified and the proofs in CompressionLeanRust, as separate Lake libraries
why: Aeneas writes NeoVerified.* imports, and separate libraries let CI build them without the whole project
result: builds in seconds with the Aeneas release build

decision: each proved port gets a Sound theorem with no premise and a Complete theorem with a premise and a witness, checked by CompressionLeanRustTests
why: Sound alone holds for a function that always fails; papers 2026/670 and 2026/2441 show proofs that promise nothing

decision: run check runs the translated Lean with lake env lean --run, not a compiled lake exe
why: a compiled exe would compile all of Mathlib to native code
result: 4272 cases agree; a planted Lean bug is caught

decision: proof-bytes pin runs the prover in a one-thread rayon pool
why: with several threads the toy proof bytes differed on 3 runs; with one thread they were equal twice
result: pin equal on old and new layout code

decision: kernel recheck uses leanchecker that ships with Lean 4.35, nightly
why: no extra install, and it rechecks the cached oleans that lake build trusts

decision: copy parts of dcSpark/ProtogaLattice into public Nightstream
why: the owner approved it on 2026-10-30

decision: moved the plan and design from docs/handoff/aeneas into .audit/aeneas-plan.md and .audit/aeneas-design.md
why: docs/ is not in git, so a reviewer could not see the plan that the code and the log cite

decision: ran the comment pass (comment-sicko) on the Phase 0 diff and kept most of its 46 deletions
why: the playbook requires it before review
evidence: comment pass report in this session

decision: put back a contract header in neo-verified lib.rs, script headers with usage, the pre-existing lean_ports.rs module doc and Inventory Port doc, the NeoVerified lakefile note, and the why of Complete
why: CLAUDE.md asks for a short contract header on protocol-critical files, and those lines were pre-existing docs or the only record of a non-obvious reason

decision: renamed power to two_pow
why: the comment pass found that the name did not say base 2 once its doc was gone

decision: added Function.Injective theorems for both views, and the shape check requires one per view
why: a view that forgets output would make Sound and Complete weaker than they read; a proof is better than a comment

decision: the run check now fails when a model in std-models.txt has no case, and Array.make got a case
why: the comment pass found that the model list claimed coverage that did not exist
result: a planted uncovered model fails the test

decision: replaced the unread Proof struct in lean_ports.rs with serde_json::Value
why: Rust never reads the proof names; Lean checks them, and the allow(dead_code) was noise

decision: rejected these comment-pass flags: a struct for split's output, an enum for hash or proof, named FNV helpers, named xorshift helpers, a field for the Complete witness
why: each adds code without catching a new bug; the shape check and the ports test already reject the bad states

decision: made commits in replay order: pin on old code, move, translation and proofs, run check
why: each commit then shows one step, and the pin commit proves the move left the bytes alone
result: intermediate commits not each rebuilt; final tree fully checked

decision: commit 2 pins the moved items by token hash, and commit 3 converts them to proof entries
why: so commit 2 passes the ports test without the proof support that commit 3 adds

decision: run leanchecker --fresh in the aeneas CI job and delete the nightly workflow
why: the comment pass found that leanchecker without --fresh still trusts the cached Mathlib and Aeneas files; --fresh takes 97 s, cheap enough for every run
